emergence.summary: The commonest inherited cardiac disease, a sarcomere contractility disorder. Two leading causal genes converge on the SAME emergent axis -- the cardiac sarcomere's contractile output -- and drive it UP (hypercontractility): MYH7 (beta-myosin heavy chain) missense alleles are GAIN-OF-FUNCTION (more force-generating cross-bridges / raised actin-activated ATPase), and MYBPC3 (cardiac myosin-binding protein C) truncating alleles are LOSS-OF-FUNCTION of a normal BRAKE on cross-bridge cycling (haploinsufficiency disinhibits contraction). Both therefore perturb the contractile axis UP, producing left-ventricular hypertrophy, hyperdynamic systole, impaired relaxation, and (often) dynamic outflow obstruction. This is read as a NEW KIND of emergent axis for the kit -- a MECHANICAL / contractile axis (force, cross-bridge duty ratio), not a chemical concentration, enzyme throughput, ion or hormone level -- driven UP, so the corrective direction is to RESTRAIN it. The kit re-derives the approved restrain arm -- mavacamten, a cardiac myosin inhibitor that lowers the number of force-generating myosin cross-bridges and thereby the hypercontractile output (the first sarcomere-targeted HCM drug). MYH7 is the deeper switch (higher gamma) and is picked as the primary; MYBPC3 is the second causal switch, both perturbing UP. Restoring the MYBPC3 brake (gene-level) is recorded as a restrain-coded lever because its NET effect on the emergent contractile axis is to LOWER it (the same net-effect lever convention used for OTC, where restoring the deficient gene is coded by its axis effect, not its molecular direction). Symptomatic agents (beta-blockers, non-dihydropyridine calcium-channel blockers, disopyramide) reduce rate/obstruction but do NOT target the sarcomere hypercontractility switch and are recorded as downstream-symptomatic, NOT switch levers (the XLH/Rett downstream-agent discipline). The gamma reads are of the MYH7 and MYBPC3 locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are coding (MYH7 missense e.g. p.Arg403Gln; MYBPC3 truncating/splice e.g. founder c.3628-41_3628-17del, p.Trp792fs), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: MYH7 encodes the beta-cardiac myosin heavy chain, the force-generating motor of the ventricular sarcomere. HCM missense alleles are gain-of-function: they raise actin-activated ATPase and the fraction of myosin heads available for force generation (destabilising the auto-inhibited super-relaxed state), i.e. hypercontractility -> the contractile axis is pushed UP. Located 14q11.2 (CMH1, OMIM 192600). NCBI official symbol MYH7. Autosomal dominant. Coding missense lesions (e.g. p.Arg403Gln, p.Arg453Cys); promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Geisterfer-Lowrance 1990 Cell 62:999 (MYH7 Arg403Gln, the first HCM mutation); Alfares 2015 Genet Med 17:880 (MYH7/MYBPC3 dominate HCM genetics); Anderson 2018 PNAS 115:E7486 (HCM alleles destabilise the super-relaxed state -> hypercontractility)

per_gene.note: MYBPC3 encodes cardiac myosin-binding protein C, which normally RESTRAINS actomyosin cross-bridge cycling (a brake that slows/limits contraction). Most HCM alleles are truncating -> haploinsufficiency -> loss of the brake -> disinhibited cross-bridge cycling -> hypercontractility -> the contractile axis is pushed UP (same direction as MYH7 GOF). Located 11p11.2 (CMH4, OMIM 115197). NCBI official symbol MYBPC3. Autosomal dominant; a common founder truncating allele exists in South Asian populations. Coding/splice truncating lesions; promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Watkins 1995 Nat Genet 11:434 and Bonne 1995 Nat Genet 11:438 (MYBPC3 mutations in HCM); Harris 2002 Circ Res 90:594 (MyBP-C restrains cross-bridge cycling / brake function); Dhandapany 2009 Nat Genet 41:187 (MYBPC3 25bp founder deletion)

falsifiers.claim: MYH7 GOF and MYBPC3 LOF both raise sarcomere contractile output (hypercontractility)
falsifiers.falsifier: a MYH7 GOF or MYBPC3 truncating allele that LOWERED actin-activated myosin ATPase / cross-bridge cycling / contractile force refutes the axis-UP direction for that gene
falsifiers.measurable_by: actin-activated myosin ATPase, in-vitro motility / cross-bridge kinetics and cardiomyocyte force in MYH7-mutant and MYBPC3-haploinsufficient sarcomeres (patient iPSC-cardiomyocytes, mouse models)

falsifiers.claim: restraining contractility (myosin inhibition) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if reducing myosin cross-bridge cycling RAISED contractile output or WORSENED the hypertrophic/obstructive phenotype, the restrain lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: fractional shortening / LV outflow gradient and sarcomere force response to a cardiac myosin inhibitor in HCM cardiomyocytes and patients
